summary: Indian stocks head into the weekend after snapping a three-day winning run on inflation worries, with mixed results after the bell and steady US futures setting a cautious tone for Monday.

detail.leaders: Pharma and healthcare, which held up on Friday; foreign buying remains a support
detail.laggards: Rate-sensitive realty and autos while inflation worries persist; Eicher Motors after a profit miss
detail.tone: A forward-looking read for Monday's session. A little steadier than during Friday's trade, as US futures edge higher, but the inflation and rate-hike overhang remains.
